summary: KIZILKAN PLAYER v4.0.0 Ultimate Edition — 6th iteration verified. BACKEND: 22/22 pytest still green (Health, M3U parse-url/content/invalid, Xtream login/vod/series/vod-info/series-info/catchup-epg all invalid-path 400s, Stalker invalid-MAC + unreachable-portal 400/401s, EPG fetch/now-next/channel, DVR schedule/list/delete). No regression. FRONTEND FAZ 6 NEW: (1) Animated splash `/` — testID root-loader visible, KIZILKAN logo + red neon glow + neon loading bar render on first mount, then routes to /onboarding when no playlists (verified via URL change). (2) Onboarding renders KIZILKAN header + hooded silhouette hero + Turkish tagline 'Kişisel IPTV deneyiminiz başlıyor' + primary CTA 'Oynatma Listesi Ekle'. (3) /add-playlist — 4 source-type chips (M3U URL / M3U Dosya / Xtream / MAG), 'Demo listeyi kullan (iptv-org TR)' quick link fills the URL. After 'Kaydet ve Yükle', backend /api/m3u/parse-url succeeds and app navigates to /(tabs) with 206 channels visible in the demo iptv-org TR list. (4) Search tab `/search` — search-screen loads with empty-state icon + 'Kanal, film, dizi veya oyuncu adı yazın'. Fuzzy search verified end-to-end: `spor` → 13 sonuç across 4 scope chips (Tümü/Kanallar/Filmler/Diziler) — A Spor / beIN Sports Haber / FB TV / HTSpor / S Sport / Sports TV all matched. `haber` → 10 sonuç (Haber61, Haber Global, Habertürk, A Haber, beIN Sports Haber, Flash Haber, ON Medya Haber…). Scope chips rendered: search-scope-all/live/vod/series (NOTE: internal key for channels is 'live', not 'channels' — my initial testID guess was wrong, not a bug). (5) Kütüphane tab `/favorites` — favorites-screen renders '📚 Kütüphanem' title + stats button (top-right chart icon) + 4 sub-tabs lib-tab-continue/favorites/watchlist/recent. Empty state 'Devam edilecek bir film veya dizi yok' with play icon. (6) `/stats` — reached via library-stats-btn tap, testID stats-screen visible + stats-back-btn works. (7) Settings `/settings` — all 9 target testIDs present: feature-multi-view-btn, feature-epg-timeline-btn, feature-backup-btn, feature-dvr-btn, feature-stats-btn, feature-shortcuts-btn, feature-notification-btn, feature-siri-btn, hidden-manager-btn. (8) Info modals: feature-shortcuts-btn → shortcuts-info-ok-btn visible; feature-siri-btn → siri-info-ok-btn visible; feature-notification-btn → notif-info-ok-btn visible (the three native-only scaffolds correctly show informational modals as expected). (9) Player screen testIDs verified in code: player-speed-btn (⚡ label with current rate), player-stats-btn, player-record-btn, plus SheetItem testIDs speed-0.5/0.75/1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2-btn; progress persistence hook logic present for vodplay-/epplay- prefixes. (10) Long-press channel handler wired at (tabs)/index.tsx:83 → Alert.alert with Favori toggle / Gizle (destructive) / İptal actions — Alert.alert is a native RN API and does not render visibly on web preview, so verification was via source code only. (11) hidden-manager PIN gating exists: hidden-manager-btn is present in Settings; direct nav to /hidden-manager renders and requires PIN via ParentalContext when PIN is set. NO red-screen crashes. NO runtime console errors (0 errors during the combined flow). All Turkish text preserved. No deprecated Expo packages: uses expo-video (not expo-av), expo-camera not present, expo-background-task not required.

react_native_issues.issue: Web preview emits 'shadow* / textShadow* style props are deprecated', 'pointerEvents is deprecated', 'resizeMode is deprecated', and 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — all originate from expo-router/vector-icons on react-native-web and Animated on web. Non-blocking, no functional impact on native builds.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-forward from FAZ 5): In /app/frontend/app/player.tsx around lines 316-339, wire success/error feedback for the player-record-btn (currently silent both on success and in catch{}). Suggest a lightweight toast/chip so the user knows the DVR schedule was actually saved.
OPTIONAL (carry-forward from FAZ 4): Add TextInput wired to `search` state in /app/frontend/app/multi-view.tsx picker modal, OR remove the dead `search` state.
OPTIONAL (carry-forward): silence react-native-web shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/resizeMode/useNativeDriver deprecation warnings on web build (cosmetic only).
OPTIONAL (carry-forward): /app/backend/server.py has grown large (~837+ lines). Consider splitting into modules (m3u.py / xtream.py / stalker.py / epg.py / dvr.py) as a hygiene refactor.

INFO for the user: expo-quick-actions (Home-Screen Shortcuts), expo-notifications MediaSession control, and Siri Universal Search require a native EAS build to actually register. Current Settings screen correctly shows informative Turkish modals for all three (shortcuts-info-ok-btn / notif-info-ok-btn / siri-info-ok-btn) — this is the intended scaffolding, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx (splash) uses react-native-reanimated shared values + LinearGradient for the ambient glow — clean animation code, honors themeLoading/profilesLoading/isLoading gates before routing.
search.tsx uses a shared fuzzy scorer (/app/frontend/src/utils/fuzzy.ts) across live channels, VOD, series — good DRY. Scope chip counts are derived reactively.
favorites.tsx correctly renders 4 sub-tabs (continue/favorites/watchlist/recent) with per-tab empty states in Turkish; hooks into LibraryContext for state.
(tabs)/index.tsx:83 uses Alert.alert for long-press quick actions — correct on native; will fall back to browser confirm on web (partial, not a bug).
settings.tsx has 785 lines — near the 700-line threshold; consider splitting Profile/Parental/Playlist/EPG/Feature sections into sub-components before more growth.
player.tsx:485 speed sheet uses SheetItem testIDs speed-0.5-btn … speed-2-btn — correct wiring. player-stats-btn opens setSheet('stats').
hidden-manager.tsx + hidden-pin.tsx wire PIN gating via ParentalContext — routing correct: /hidden-pin on success replaces to /hidden-manager (verified in code).
LibraryContext (186 lines) exposes toggleFavorite, toggleWatchlist, addRecent, upsertProgress, clearProgress and persists via AsyncStorage — good state design.
quickActions.ts wraps expo-quick-actions API in try/catch — silent no-op on web/Expo Go, correct scaffolding.
app.json declared version 4.0.0 (confirmed) with expo-quick-actions plugin + expo-notifications; only native-build features are gated behind info modals — good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the 6th iteration scope — splash, onboarding, add-playlist demo flow, main screen with 206 channels, fuzzy search (spor/haber), library 4 sub-tabs, stats screen nav, settings 9 new feature buttons, 3 native-only info modals (shortcuts/siri/notification). Player speed/stats/record testIDs verified in source. Long-press Alert verified via source (Alert.alert is native-only).
